2026-10-18-inventory-performance-lto.jso.role: Previous optimized inventory executable/source/build provenance, with its original samples.

scope: Only existing observations are packaged; no native build, execution, profiling, or timing is performed.
The measured source snapshot comes from Git commit e9c2a879ff258892ffe8d2c6862b5fa7688eea57, independently of later documentation edits. Historical results are excluded.

All 84 retained local evidence paths from the reviewed validation index are included, with source/log hashes and corrected-fixture rationale. Initial uncommitted fixture contents were not retained and are not reconstructed.
Native executables, runtime archives, interpreters, toolchains, bytecode caches, and native .text dumps are excluded. Their paths/hashes remain in the original records.
Raw timing JSON is separately gzip-compressed without byte changes. Previous baseline timing records remain separately published and are referenced by exact compressed/decompressed hashes.
Tar members are sorted regular files with mode 0644, uid/gid/mtime 0, empty owner names, and gzip filename empty/mtime 0. Metadata uses the recorded timing completion time, not packaging time.
Audits using executable/toolchain files and Git objects need those preserved external artifacts; published JSON, source, logs, and LLVM support independent review and recomputation.
